title: It stopped first. So who goes now? 🛑 #shorts
description:
The car on your right got there first and already stopped. Do you go, or does it?
Comment A, B, C or D 👇

#roadrules #driving #drivingtest #quiz #noggin #shorts

scenes.question: Who goes first?
options: The car, it's on your right
The car, it got there first
You, the car has a STOP sign
scenes.why: STOP beats the right-hand rule. That car must wait, even if it got there first.

different: Some crossroads have STOP signs on every road. There, the first to arrive goes first.
The STOP sign is a red triangle, not an octagon.
